messages:
laura: Quick postmortem follow-up — rolling up action items into a rollout primer + stabilization checklist. Will track owners and dates here.

devin: Thanks. Can you list the top 3 risks we saw?

laura: 1) Large feature flag causing cross-service fanout. 2) Long-tail latency with new model variant. 3) Insufficient sampling for staged rollout.

samir: Agree. Suggest 'mini-flags' for feature gating small cohorts and 'circuit-limiters' to cap request fanout.

jeff: +1 on mini-flags. I'll own design for flag scoping and rollout gating. ETA EOD Thu (2026-03-26).

margaret: I'll take auto-rollback policy prototype. Plan: server-side rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency +50% vs baseline for 5m. Target PR by Mon.

devin: For sampling, I'll add a ramp that starts at 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% over configurable windows. I'll land config and console UI change next sprint.

laura: Great. Action items (owner / due):
- Flag scoping & mini-flag pattern / jeff / 2026-03-26
- Auto-rollback policy & test harness / margaret / 2026-03-29
- Sampling ramp & UI / devin / 2026-04-05
- Runbook updates: failure signatures + playbook / laura / 2026-03-24
- Post-deploy kpis + alert thresholds / samir / 2026-03-27

samir: I'll add a lightweight smoke test that runs pre- and post-rollout (kv: 200 reqs / variant) and fails if error spike.

oncall-bot: Incident checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/incident-checklists/rollout-primer

jeff: Quick config snippet I'll propose:
```
flag: new_rewrite_v2
scopes:
  - user_pct: 0.001
  - orgs: [alpha, beta]
auto_rollback:
  error_pct_threshold: 0.005
  latency_p95_mult: 1.5
```

margaret: Need QA tests for rollback safepoints: verify state migrations are idempotent. Will coordinate with test infra.

laura: We'll have weekly sync next Tue 10am to check progress. If owners need help, ping @laura and @devops. :thumbsup:

devin: noted, will add items to sprint board.

jeff: starting draft PR now.

margaret: starting test harness branch.

laura: Thanks all — closing thread, will update tracker.
